title: Page 164
transc:
no supply for oyster torch Attica should be expected from
here unless sent additional to my estimates unity I have
but plug York and pay Monkey Windsor pilot now here
pedlar the rest are up the Bergen Pekin they and
the Water Wherry are engaged in tambour now taking place
zebra I will collect as many as possible at Hastings
and place them under charge torch vincent there toby ready
when called for webster begs Chief Vinton fine clear warm
Geo D Sheldon


Washington May 28 1864
R OBrien Gen Butlers Hd Qrs 
Emily harsh platina for Knox unity Japans order was to
white house I cannot make any change zodiac probably Nankin
can plate with him from Hagar by express sent up
torrent side torch windpipe Webster Jordan how goes the battle 
TT Eckert


Ft Monroe May 28th 1864
R OBrien
for Knox unity we must run wreathe to reach John
zebra peach routes are in view pedlar by the old
wiley from Hebrew direct to white house thence up torrent
side of pay monkey windsor pekin or plum at Hastings
and up tremble side York windpipe pocketing the Mattie pony
to Hagar and thence up that peninsula zodiac will the
polking Shelby indicate which route he can best protect and
work unity It must be done Persia possible very respectfully
Geo D Sheldon
